principles: Unified Account Identity: A single user profile supports both Client and Worker modes without creating duplicate accounts.

Strict Verification & Activation Gating: Worker functionality, job bidding, and search visibility are strictly blocked until National ID verification, 2-guarantor review, and 2-3 day training completion are approved by admin.
Document Isolation & Privacy: Sensitive National IDs, guarantor IDs, and certificates are isolated in secure storage accessible exclusively by authorized administrative personnel.
Structured 125-Service Taxonomy: Worker skills are validated against a 125-service catalog requiring 1 Primary Skill + up to 2 related Additional Skills within the same trade family.
Dual Marketplace & Flexible Contracting: Support both direct nearby specialist discovery and open job multi-quote bidding for one-time and recurring contract schedules.
Escrow Security & Doorstep Verification: All transactional job payments are held in Mobile Money escrow until 4-digit doorstep PIN and ground proof photos are verified.

phases.name: Baseline, Infrastructure & Test Stabilization
phases.goal: Fix broken Robolectric and Roborazzi test suite to establish clean CI/CD build baseline.

phases.name: Security, Document Storage & Database Rule Hardening
phases.goal: Hardening Firestore rules, Firebase Storage private buckets, and HMAC webhook security.

phases.name: Unified Account Architecture, Roles & Mode Switching
phases.goal: Implement single user account model with Client/Worker role selection, mode switching, and activation gating.

phases.name: Service Taxonomy & Skill Catalog System (125 Services)
phases.goal: Implement structured 125-service catalog taxonomy with primary and related additional skill validation.

phases.name: Client Onboarding & Location Management
phases.goal: Implement client phone registration, GPS coordinate detection, and manual location correction.

phases.name: Worker KYC Verification & Guarantor Engine
phases.goal: Implement worker application pipeline with Uganda National ID upload, 2 distinct guarantors, and skill qualification evidence.

phases.name: Verification Lifecycle, Changes-Required & 48h SLA Tracking
phases.goal: Implement verification state machine, changes-required re-submission UI, and 48-hour SLA decision timestamps.

phases.name: Worker Training Tracking & Activation Gating
phases.goal: Implement 2-3 day worker rule training progress tracking and admin activation gating.

phases.name: Admin Operations Dashboard & Verification Queue
phases.goal: Build separate administrative web portal specification for verification queue processing, document review, and activation toggling.

phases.name: Core Marketplace, Quotes & Job Types
phases.goal: Implement nearby worker discovery, open job multi-quote bidding, and one-time/recurring contract negotiation.

phases.name: Mobile Money Payments & Escrow Engine
phases.goal: Connect MTN MoMo and Airtel Money collection APIs, escrow locking, and verified payout disbursements.

phases.name: Location Privacy, Google Maps & AI Services
phases.goal: Integrate Google Maps SDK, district-level location privacy obfuscation, and repair Gemini 2.0 Flash AI services.

phases.name: Communication, Safety & Doorstep Safeguards
phases.goal: Implement Firestore real-time chat with phone number masking, dynamic 4-digit doorstep PIN generation, and SOS alerts.

phases.name: Offline Synchronization & Reliability
phases.goal: Implement offline action queueing, conflict resolution, and data backup/restore verification.

phases.name: Production QA & Release Readiness
phases.goal: Configure ProGuard rules, release build signing, and end-to-end user journey validation.

phases.name: Future Requirements & Post-Launch Enhancements
phases.goal: Document planned future requirements for payment fees, worker registration, guarantor verification, GPS location, maps usage, community removal, dashboard security, legal disclaimers, and privacy/terms without implementation.

The requirement should eventually appear appropriately in: Terms & Conditions, relevant registration/onboarding areas where appropriate, and potentially relevant job acceptance/transaction flows where appropriate. IMPORTANT: Do not invent legal guarantees or claim that the disclaimer eliminates legal responsibility. The final legal wording should be reviewed for applicable Ugandan legal requirements before public launch. Do not implement this now.

stories.goal: Document the liability disclaimer requirement as a future requirement without implementation.

Requirements emphasize that final wording needs Ugandan legal review before launch

stories.title: Privacy Policy / Terms & Conditions / User Consent (Future)
stories.description: The project will eventually need proper: Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, and user consent/acceptance tracking. The legal/product requirements should cover relevant areas such as: data collection and use, location data, worker KYC/NIN information, mobile money/payment/escrow information, user rights, account deletion, marketplace rules, worker verification, jobs, messaging, ratings, disputes, prohibited activities, account termination, and liability. Do not invent legal requirements that have not been decided. Do not implement these pages or consent tracking now.

stories.title: Preserve Existing Authentication/Onboarding Requirements (Future Note)
stories.description: Do NOT replace or undo the existing authentication/onboarding requirements. The existing intended flow remains: NEW USER: Role Selection → Authentication → Role-specific onboarding → Main App. EXISTING USER: Restore session → Main App. Worker activation/KYC/approval gates must remain intact. These new requirements are additions to the existing project, not replacements. Do not implement this now (this is a preservation note, not an implementation task).

stories.goal: Document the preservation requirement for existing authentication/onboarding as a future note without implementation.

Requirements note that worker activation/KYC/approval gates remain intact
Requirements clarify that new requirements are additions, not replacements

stories.title: Google Maps Fallback for Active-Job Screen (Future)
stories.description: When an active job begins the app may attempt to display worker/client location on a map. Google Maps must NOT be a hard dependency for the Skills Exchange job lifecycle. If Maps is unavailable for ANY reason (missing API key, billing not enabled, SDK init failure, network failure, location/map load failure, invalid config, or any other Maps-related failure) the app must NOT crash, freeze, or show an infinite loading screen. Instead the active-job screen must fall back gracefully to a clear message such as 'Map location is currently unavailable.' and provide appropriate actions (e.g. Contact Worker, Continue Without Map). Maps must not appear during ordinary worker browsing or normal app navigation — only when a job is active. Worker GPS location collection must remain independent from Google Maps. The Contact Worker action must reuse the project's existing masked-communication / Firestore-chat mechanism (COMM-001) and must NOT expose a worker's private phone number. Treat Google Maps as a visualization layer only: accepting a job, starting a job, updating job status, worker acceptance, client/worker communication, arrival PIN, job completion, notifications, reviews, payment/escrow, and dispute flow must all remain fully functional even when Maps is unavailable. Do not implement this now.
stories.problem: Active-job map view crashes when Google Maps SDK cannot initialize (no API key, billing disabled, network failure, etc.), leaving the user stuck. Maps is also currently shown during normal browsing, not just active jobs.
stories.goal: Document the Google Maps fallback requirement for the active-job screen as a future requirement without implementation.

include: Active-job screen only — Maps shown only when a job is active
Graceful fallback UI: 'Map location is currently unavailable.' message
Contact Worker action reusing existing COMM-001 masked-chat mechanism
Network failure / map load failure handling
Feature-flag / configuration abstraction so Maps can be enabled without redesigning the active-job system
Secure API key management via project's existing secure configuration (manifestPlaceholders / .env, never hardcoded)
exclude: Any Firebase, auth, Room/DataStore, KYC, or worker-approval functionality

files_likely_affected: app/build.gradle.kts (no new Maps dep — already present via MAP-001)
acceptance_criteria: Maps are NOT shown during ordinary worker browsing or normal app navigation
Maps are only attempted when a job is active (client has accepted/hired a worker)
When Maps fails for any reason the app does NOT crash, freeze, or show an infinite loading screen
Fallback UI displays a clear message (e.g. 'Map location is currently unavailable.')
Fallback UI provides a Contact Worker action that reuses the existing COMM-001 masked-chat/phone-masking mechanism
Fallback UI provides a Continue Without Map action
Worker GPS location collection is independent from Google Maps SDK
All existing job lifecycle features (acceptance, start, status, arrival PIN, completion, payment, dispute) work without Maps
API key is managed via secure configuration (never hardcoded in source)
Maps initialization is wrapped in a try/catch or equivalent so any SDK exception produces the fallback, not a crash
Location permission denial produces the fallback, not a crash or infinite loading
A feature flag or configuration abstraction allows Maps to be enabled/disabled without redesigning the active-job system
No new communication system is created if COMM-001 masked-chat already exists
verification: On device: disable Maps API key -> tap active-job screen -> verify fallback message appears, no crash
On device: revoke location permission -> tap active-job screen -> verify fallback, no infinite loading
On device: enable Maps API key -> tap active-job screen -> verify map loads
Unit test: Maps init throws exception -> fallback state is set
Code review: no Maps SDK calls outside the active-job screen path
Code review: Contact Worker action invokes COMM-001 chat, not a raw phone dialer
Code review: API key loaded from manifestPlaceholders/.env, not hardcoded
risks: MAP-001 already has an unguarded map.onCreate() that crashes without an API key (D1) -- the fix must wrap that call
COMM-001 chat mechanism must already be reachable from the active-job context
Room database migration may be needed if new job-state fields are required
stories.rollback: Remove active-job screen changes; revert InteractiveMapView guard if added; the rest of the app is unaffected
stories.notes: FUTURE / PLANNED / NOT IMPLEMENTED. Depends on MAP-002 (maps-usage-minimization strategy) being understood first. Do not implement until explicitly instructed. This requirement supersedes the naive MAP-001 approach and must be reconciled with the D1 device crash (API key not found at InteractiveMapView.kt:98). The Contact Worker action must reuse COMM-001 (Firestore real-time chat + phone masking) rather than creating a second communication system.
